universe.membership_rule: Use the last snapshot with date <= signal_date. Eligible symbols = members ∩ symbols with valid prices at formation start and end.
universe.ticker_cleanup: Drop annotated delist tickers matching TICKER-YYYYMM. Map BRK.B-style dots to broker convention as needed.

signal.when: Last trading day of each calendar month (month-end close).
signal.formation_end: Close of the trading day that is (skip_trading_days + 1) sessions before signal_date (i.e. exclude signal day and skip 21 more).
signal.select: Highest top_n scores among eligible names.
signal.fallback: If fewer than max(5, top_n//2) valid scores, target 90% SPY / 10% cash (or 100% cash if SPY unavailable).

execution.signal_bar: month_end close used only for computing the signal (no fills on that bar).
execution.trade_bar: Next trading session after signal (lag=1): submit market/MOC orders to reach target weights.
execution.target_weights: Each pick gets portfolio_gross_weight / N. Residual cash_weight stays uninvested.
execution.missing_price_policy: If a held name has no quote on trade day, exit using last good mark / last trade; never delete shares without credit.
execution.between_rebalances: Hold target names; optional daily drift rebalance to keep ~90% invested is allowed but not required. Do not change the name list until next month-end signal.

research_metrics_reference.note: Backtest metrics from research DB; paper results will differ.
